column1: # roll-up targets for cell_type_ontology_term_id; read by rollup.py, which fails on an id
# not in the pinned CL release or a label that differs from it. Each native term rolls up to
# its most specific is_a ancestor-or-self in this list; when several are equally specific
# (none is an ancestor of another) the one listed FIRST wins, so row order is a decision.
# row order: lineage-specific targets first, then generic ones (ciliated cell, myeloid cell,
# ... epithelial cell), so a term under both a lineage and a generic or feature-defined class
# rolls up to the lineage. Two orderings break that on purpose: endocrine cell sits just before
# neuron, because CL puts neuroendocrine cells (pulmonary, prostate, chromaffin, adrenal
# medulla type I) under both and they are secretory epithelial-derived cells, not neurons; and
# conventional precedes plasmacytoid dendritic cell because CL puts CD141-positive myeloid
# origin: panel = expected term of the proving_ground.py marker panel; proving_ground_broad =
# its EXTRA_ROLLUP competitors; extended = added here for lineage coverage
